entries.scope: G3 no-IALMob Id-Vg, Vd=0.1 V, exact SProcess topology, Vg=0--5 V; dominant unresolved interval Vg=0--0.6667 V
entries.observation: The qualified contact-boundary ElectricField HFS fallback and cached-mobility Jacobian repair allow all 31 no-predictor G3 points to converge, but the production P95 current error remains 0.432753 dex. At Vg=0.5 V the production curve and independent Sentaurus-seed reclose reconcile exactly at Id=1.736470037555399e-10 A/um, 2.687099x or 0.429284 dex above Sentaurus; no warm-start multiple-solution discrepancy is present. A complete T-2022.03-SP2 MeasureCoefficients.debug replay over 5674 active electron rows reduces fixed-state electron residual L2 and maximum to 0.0173075x and 0.0433710x, respectively, without changing the initial Poisson residual. The explicit, default-off templates_ldmos_external_averagebox transport profile passes analytic-Jacobian, fixed-state and one-Newton gates. A subsequent 2x2 same-bias factorial identifies two nearly orthogonal contract defects. AverageBox transport closes 0.136312--0.140239 dex independent of the Ohmic-contact policy. The Templates/LDMOS source terminal physically shorts p+ body pickup and n+ source nodes, but the default dominant_signed_contact_mean treats the real p+ segment as opposite-sign outliers and reconstructs it as n+ boundary data. This produces the bias-independent 1.0818503857 V maximum psi family and a 40.84 mV hole-QF offset. Explicit legacy_node_local reconstruction restores the local p+/n+ polarity, closes 0.276004--0.279931 dex independent of transport couple, and reduces maximum state differences to psi/phin/phip=29.23/5.247/0.231 mV. The qualified node-local plus AverageBox reclose converges in three Newton iterations with KCL relative error 1.10e-11 and Id=6.65923465680782e-11 A/um, only 1.030483x or 0.013041 dex above Sentaurus. These are correctable template contact and discretization contracts, not an engine floor; a 31-point confirmation has not yet been run.
